dev.social.bad_domain.note: Error shown after "Could not send the request: " when the owner adds a friend by an address that isn't a device on the bridge. {domain} is the address typed; {tld} is the bridge's domain, such as off-the.cloud.

dev.social.blocked.text: you blocked this device - unblock it before sending a request
dev.social.blocked.note: Error shown after "Could not send the request: " when the owner sends a friend request to a device they blocked earlier (Friends).

dev.social.change_status_failed.text: Error trying to change friend status: {detail}
dev.social.change_status_failed.note: Error reply in Friends when accepting, blocking or unblocking a friend failed. {detail} is the reason: one of the device's own sentences, or an error in English it can't translate.

dev.social.comment_failed.note: Error reply in Social when posting a comment failed. {detail} is the reason: one of the device's own sentences, or an error in English it can't translate.

dev.social.comment_likers_failed.note: Error reply in Social when the list of people who liked a comment could not be read. {detail} is the reason, usually an error in English the device can't translate.

dev.social.delete_comment_failed.note: Error reply in Social when deleting a comment failed. {detail} is the reason: one of the device's own sentences, or an error in English it can't translate.

dev.social.delete_friendship_failed.text: Error trying to delete the friendship: {detail}
dev.social.delete_friendship_failed.note: Error reply in Friends when removing a friend (or a friend request) failed. {detail} is the reason: one of the device's own sentences, or an error in English it can't translate.

dev.social.delete_post_failed.note: Error reply in Social when deleting one of the owner's posts failed. A publication is a post. {detail} is the reason: one of the device's own sentences, or an error in English it can't translate.

dev.social.events_failed.note: Error reply when the list of recent social activity (posts, comments, likes) could not be read. {detail} is the reason, usually an error in English the device can't translate.

dev.social.friendship_lookup_failed.note: Error reply to a friend's device asking whether a friendship still exists, when the device could not read it. Friends' devices show it to their owner as a detail. {detail} is an error in English. ("retreiving" is a typo kept from the English that ships; translate as "retrieving".)

dev.social.friendships_failed.note: Error reply in Friends when the list of friends could not be read. {detail} is the reason, usually an error in English the device can't translate.

dev.social.like_comment_failed.note: Error reply in Social when liking a comment failed. {detail} is the reason, usually an error in English the device can't translate.

dev.social.like_post_failed.note: Error reply in Social when liking a post failed. A publication is a post. {detail} is the reason, usually an error in English the device can't translate.

dev.social.load_file_failed.note: Error shown after "error trying to create publication: " when a file chosen for a new post could not be read. {path} is the file's path on the device; {detail} is the reason: one of the device's own sentences, or an error in English it can't translate.

dev.social.media_not_available.note: Error reply when a photo or video of a post can't be shown (it is gone, or a friend asked for media of a post that isn't the owner's own).

dev.social.no_friendship_with.note: Error shown after "Error trying to delete the friendship: " when the friend to remove isn't in the list any more. {domain} is the friend's device address, such as anna.off-the.cloud.

dev.social.no_longer_friends.note: Error reply to a friend's device that was removed from the friends list and is only allowed to fetch the request to delete what it shared. Friends' devices show it as a detail.

dev.social.no_such_comment.note: Error shown after "error deleting comment: " when the comment no longer exists.

dev.social.no_such_post.note: Error reply when a friend's device asks for the files of a post that isn't the owner's own (or doesn't exist). A publication is a post.

dev.social.not_accepted.note: Error reply to a friend's device that tried to sign in without an accepted friendship (still pending, blocked or removed). Friends' devices show it to their owner as a detail.

dev.social.not_found.note: Error reply to a friend's device when this device holds no friendship with it (checking a friend request, or removing a friendship). Friends' devices show it to their owner as a detail.

dev.social.not_found_error.note: Error reply to a friend's device that asked to remove a friendship this device doesn't have. Friends' devices show it to their owner as a detail.

dev.social.not_your_comment.text: not your comment, nor a comment on one of your posts
dev.social.not_your_comment.note: Error shown after "error deleting comment: " when the owner tries to delete a friend's comment on a friend's post: only their own comments, and comments on their own posts, can be deleted.

dev.social.not_your_post.note: Error shown after "error deleting publication: " when the owner tries to delete a friend's post. A publication is a post.

dev.social.post_failed.note: Error reply in Social when publishing a new post failed. A publication is a post. {detail} is the reason: one of the device's own sentences, or an error in English it can't translate.

dev.social.post_likers_failed.note: Error reply in Social when the list of people who liked a post could not be read. {detail} is the reason, usually an error in English the device can't translate.

dev.social.posts_failed.note: Error reply in Social when the feed's posts (or one post's files) could not be read. A publication is a post. {detail} is the reason, usually an error in English the device can't translate.

dev.social.request_failed.note: Error shown in Friends when a friend request could not be sent. {detail} is the reason: one of the device's own sentences, the friend's device's words in English, or an error in English the device can't translate.

dev.social.request_refused.note: Reason a friend request from a device the owner blocked is refused, sent back to that device (shown after "Error: "). Friends' devices show it to their owner as a detail.

dev.social.request_refused_error.note: Error reply to a device whose friend request carried an address too long to be any device's. Friends' devices show it to their owner as a detail.

dev.social.video_thumbnail_failed.note: Error shown after "error trying to create publication: " when the device could not make the preview picture of a video it shrank for a post. {path} is the video's path on the device; {detail} is the reason, usually an error in English the device can't translate.
